notes: Mood-only mini images for vectorthunder.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen vectorthunder-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish vectorthunder-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.
